attackers_goals: An attacker is attempting to evade detection.
description: A user created a new local account with the name of a default local account, such as Guest and DefaultAccount. An attacker may create a user with these known names to evade detection.
investigative_actions: Check what rights and permissions were granted to the new user. Verify the action with the user who created the new account. Follow actions and activities of the newly created default account. Monitor the addition of the user to different groups.
name: Masquerading as a default local account
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
